title: crypt0graff
tagline: crypt0graffs mission is to enable all members in graffiti's ecosystem to take part in its growth by contributing a defi based value system.
description: This project is a DAO - that mints photos graffiti - found locally in exchange for access to the community and microeconomy for creators and collectors.  Community snapshots are taken and active members are airdropped tokens based on graffiti based achievements outside the DAO in the real world.
how_its_made: Using React.js as our frontend framework, also using geist-ui for quick UI creation and styles - We used thirdweb as our main contract provider in deploying our minting, dao voting contracts.  We then assembled all those pieces by using IPFS's storage infrastructure to store our users submitted graffiti, tag name and location.  We then used NFTport for querying submitted graffiti from the Polygon blockchain.
